description: Get one caller persona (profile) by `id` (from listProfiles, or the profileId on a mission test, sweep or survey config; ids start with profile_): name, description and `items`, what the persona brings to a call: voice items name an audio clip (audioId, see getAudio) and data items name a dataset value (datasetId and itemId, see getDataset), each with the label a test binds to. Use when: you have a profile id and want to say who the caller is. To find one by name use listProfiles. Read-only. Needs data:read. Returns 404 if the persona is not in your workspace.

id.description:
Profile identifier (prefix `profile_` followed by a base-36 timestamp + random;
NOT a uuid, unlike most other ids in the spec).

name: getProfile

outputSchema.description:
Workspace-scoped profile of named voice + data items, used to instantiate
parameterised tests. Items reference audio rows and/or dataset items via id.

id.description: Profile id (prefix `profile_` followed by a base-36 timestamp + random).

items.description:
Union of voice items (`type: voice`) and data items (`type: data`). The `type`
discriminator selects between `ProfileVoiceItem` and `ProfileDataItem`.

oneOf.description:
Voice item inside a profile — references an `AudioObject` by id. The `label` is
the parameter name used to match against test scripts.

audioId.description: Reference to `AudioObject.id` in the same workspace.

label.description:
Parameter label — used to match this profile against test configs that bind
to a parameter of the same name.

oneOf.description:
Data item inside a profile — references a specific `DataItem` inside a `Dataset`
by `datasetId` + `itemId`. The `label` is the parameter name used to match against
test scripts.

datasetId.description: Reference to `Dataset.id` in the same workspace.

title: Get Caller Persona
